title: EXOTIC-CCR A001: Poisson/Weyl lifts and bounded Lean-backed Theorems E-F
description: Proposed, untagged review artifact for A001. The paper-grade analysis states the H=-iX1 deficiency-index result (infinity,infinity); the companion Lean artifact proves the bounded canonical-core Theorem E via ExoticCCR.theoremE (tag v0.1.8-theorem-e, SHA a6bb091) and, proposed and under review, the bounded Theorem F via ExoticCCR.theoremF at SHA 30df8bcd310cab7a2c53d18500fcf847f1e284d2 (both adjoint eigenspaces ker(H-dagger -+ i) not finite-dimensional, with standard cardinal-valued lower bounds Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ n_+ and Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ n_-, by measure-preserving sign-involution transport of the forward minus-i families). Equality n_±=aleph0, extension multiplicity/classification, and the paper's backward-wall construction remain not Lean-covered. Prior withdrawn claims are preserved in the erratum. No new version DOI is asserted.
